FAIL_TO_PASS: return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
function-getter-side-effects: respects getters created on functions
reassign-pattern-defaults: makes sure reassignments of pattern defaults are tracked
associate-function-parameter-mutations-2: Associates function parameters with their call arguments with regard to mutations

unknown-global-call: tracks argument mutations of calls to unknown globals
break-statement-loops: breaks control flow when a break statement is encountered inside a loop
associate-function-return-values-across-other-expressions: Associates function return values with regard to mutations
invalid-property-assignments: includes invalid property assignments
custom-event-detail: observes side effects for custom event payloads
optional-chaining-namespace: supports optional chaining with namespace objects
deoptimize-nested-function-arg: deoptimizes call arguments to functions nested in function properties
side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
side-effects-generators: Properly detect side-effects in generator functions
declarations-with-side-effects: retains side-effects in declarations will tree-shaking the declared variable
namespace-missing-export-effects: handles interacting with missing namespace members
side-effect-es5-classes: omits ES5 classes which are pure (e.g. they only assign to `this`)
track-destructured-setter: tracks side effects from setters in destructuring assignments
chained-assignments: treeshakes chained assignments
supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
